description: Six channel stereo mixer with a three band EQ, pan and two sends on every channel, stereo returns, and a master EQ and level

params.text: Sets the level at the L and R outputs, -60dB to 0dB, starting at -30dB, and it scales the return inputs along with the channels
Sets the low shelf of the master mix, -10dB to +10dB, hinged at 120Hz
Sets the mid band of the master mix, -7dB to +7dB, peaking at 1300Hz
Sets the high shelf of the master mix, -7dB to +7dB, hinged at 1700Hz
Sets the level of that channel, -60dB to 0dB, and it starts fully down
Switches that channel out of the mix and back, latching on each press and lighting its lamp while the channel is muted; a muted channel feeds the sends nothing either
Sets the low shelf of that channel, -20dB to +20dB, hinged at 125Hz
Sets the mid band of that channel, -12.5dB to +12.5dB, peaking at 1200Hz
Sets the high shelf of that channel, -15dB to +15dB, hinged at 1800Hz
Pans that channel from full left to full right by attenuating the far side, so the near side never rises above the level set for the channel
Sets how much of that channel goes to the send 1 outputs, silent at the bottom and unity at the top, taken after its EQ, pan and level
Sets how much of that channel goes to the send 2 outputs, silent at the bottom and unity at the top, taken after its EQ, pan and level

inputs.text: The return for send 1, added to the matching side of the master mix after the master EQ and scaled by the master level
The return for send 2, added to the matching side of the master mix after the master EQ and scaled by the master level
The audio input of that channel; a polyphonic cable is summed to a single signal
Scales the level of that channel, multiplying the gain set by the knob by the voltage divided by 10, so 10V leaves the level as set and 0V silences it; unpatched it counts as 10V
Adds to the pan knob of that channel, 5V moving it hard to one side, and the sum is clamped at the ends of the travel

outputs.text: Carries that side of the master mix, after the master EQ and level, with the returns added in
Carries that side of the send 1 mix, each channel taken after its EQ, pan and level and scaled by its send 1 knob
Carries that side of the send 2 mix, each channel taken after its EQ, pan and level and scaled by its send 2 knob

notes: every channel also passes a fixed high pass at 35Hz and a 5dB cut above 12kHz, and the master a 35Hz high pass and a 2dB cut; nothing in the module clips the output
Every channel level knob comes up fully down and the master at -30dB, so nothing reaches the outputs until a channel is raised
